summary.text: Laura Budd is a Democratic member of the North Carolina House of Representatives from District 103, which she has represented since 2023, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Laura Budd was born in Atlanta, Georgia.
She earned a bachelor's degree from Ohio University in 1999 and a law degree from Wake Forest School of Law in 2002.

Ballotpedia lists her as president of the Matthews Athletic Recreation Association and vice president of the Piedmont Gymnastics Organization from 2020 to 2022, and as a former president of the Peace & Justice Immigration Clinic.
She succeeded Rachel Hunt in the state House.
